landing.metaTitle: Boolaa · Your people, in one cosy bubble
landing.metaDescription: Boolaa is a private, invite-only space for flatmates, friends and clubs: chat, plan events, share food, swap things and save links. No ads, no tracking.
landing.heroBody: Boolaa is a small, private space for flatmates, friends and clubs. Chat, plan things, share leftovers and swap stuff, all with the people you actually know.
landing.heroNote: Free to use. No ads, ever.
landing.howTitle: Up and running in a minute
landing.step1Body: Name it, describe it, choose how many people fit (2 to 150).
landing.step2Body: Send your invite code to the people you want in. Nobody finds your bubble without it.
landing.step3Body: Newcomers join once most members say yes. Then you chat, plan and share.
landing.featureChatBody: One live group chat per bubble, with everyone who matters.
landing.featureEventsBody: Plan dinners, game nights and trips, and see who's coming.
landing.featureFoodBody: Cooked too much? Share leftovers before they go to waste.
landing.featureMarketBody: Give away or trade things with people you trust.
landing.featureLinksBody: Keep recipes, playlists and articles together, tagged and easy to find.
landing.privacyBody: Boolaa is built for small circles, not audiences.
landing.promise1Body: Nothing is public. Only members of a bubble see what's inside, and members decide who joins.
landing.promise2Body: No ads, no third-party trackers, no feeds designed to keep you scrolling.
landing.promise3Body: We never sell your data. Delete your account in the app and your content goes with it.
landing.faq1A: Yes. Boolaa is free to use and has no ads.
landing.faq2A: Only people with your invite code can ask to join, and they get in once a majority of members approve.
landing.faq3Q: How big can a bubble be?
landing.faq3A: Between 2 and 150 people. You choose the limit when you create it.
landing.faq4Q: Can I be in more than one bubble?
landing.faq4A: Yes. Switch between your flat, your friends and your club with one tap.
landing.faq5A: Report any message, post or member, and block them so you no longer see each other. We review reports within 24 hours.
landing.faq6A: Any time, from your profile. Your profile, content and photos are deleted.
landing.finalBody: It takes a minute. Your people are waiting.
landing.footerTagline: Private bubbles for the people you live and play with.
landing.footerMadeBy: Free, no ads, open source (Apache 2.0), made with joy by Bogdan Raduta.
landing.faq7A: Boolaa is made with joy by Bogdan Raduta, a private individual, not a company. It's free, has no ads and is open source under the Apache 2.0 licence: the code is on <github>GitHub</github>.
landing.heroApps: iPhone and Android apps are on the way. Until then, Boolaa runs in any browser.
landing.featuresBody: Real screens from the app, not mock-ups.
landing.featureChatTitle: One chat for the whole bubble
landing.featureEventsTitle: Make a plan, see who's in
landing.featureMarketTitle: Give it away or swap it
landing.featureBubblesBody: Your flat, your friends, your club. Each bubble has its own colour, and you switch with one tap.
landing.promise4Body: A newcomer gets in only when more than half of the bubble approves.
